title: a torn consumer state file fails closed for every package
note: Run from the repository root. Consumer state files start absent; delete *.state.json to rerun.

steps.label: accept A (builds a real state)
steps.command: python tools/consumer.py accept results/rp1/vectors/P8/A.json --witness-log results/rp1/vectors/P8/log_A.txt --state results/rp1/vectors/P8/S.state.json

steps.label: B with the torn state T
steps.command: python tools/consumer.py accept results/rp1/vectors/P8/B.json --witness-log results/rp1/vectors/P8/log_AB.txt --state results/rp1/vectors/P8/T.state.json

steps.label: B with the intact state S
steps.command: python tools/consumer.py accept results/rp1/vectors/P8/B.json --witness-log results/rp1/vectors/P8/log_AB.txt --state results/rp1/vectors/P8/S.state.json
